title: Don't Drown
subtitle: Game Design and Development
contributions: Designed and developed a 2D submarine thriller in Unity and C#, taking ownership of both art direction and technical implementation.
Illustrated all game assets, enemies, and background environments from scratch using Procreate and Aseprite.
Programmed complex enemy mechanics and implemented core user interface navigation.

items.hoverText: I developed the game's core mechanics, including player movement, character interactions, enemy attacks, and level progression. I also implemented pop-up interfaces and added music and sound effects to make the gameplay more engaging.

I designed maze-inspired underwater levels with randomized layouts to encourage exploration and keep each playthrough unpredictable. Each level introduces something new, starting with simpler mechanics in Level 1 before gradually adding new enemies, unique abilities, and challenges.

media.alt: Maze-inspired underwater level designs for Don't Drown

items.hoverText: I created reusable pixel-art tilesets in Aseprite to build the game's underwater environments. This allowed me to maintain a consistent visual style while making it easier to design and expand different levels.

media.alt: Reusable pixel-art tilesets for Don't Drown's underwater environments

items.hoverText: I was responsible for all of the game's visual assets and design, including environments, interfaces, characters, and enemies, where I used exaggerated expressions and custom animations to bring the game to life.

media.alt: Hand-drawn characters and enemy animations for Don't Drown
